brief:
Jerusalem Electric Company announced a scheduled power outage affecting Bethlehem governorate, the Maan Wire reported. The utility said the cuts were necessary to improve service quality, ensure stable and continuous electricity supply, and develop the territory's electrical infrastructure.

The company issued the announcement to notify residents of the planned interruption but did not provide specific details about which neighborhoods would be affected or the duration of the outage. The timing and scope of the work remained unclear from the initial announcement.
